Every preview and browser is started through the verify or inspect scripts, which call withPreview in scripts/browser-runtime.mjs. withPreview allocates its port dynamically. freePort() listens on port 0 (lines 15-21) and the port is passed to Vite with --strictPort (line 25). The other tests (lines 73-88, and tests/scripts.test.ts) only run the scaffolder and start no preview or browser. Judges A and B voted pass, and the material supports them. Judge C&#39;s reason does not decide the requirement. Ports are dynamic, as C concedes. The command() watchdog (line 18) fires only when a run exceeds its limit, a scenario that neither the criterion&#39;s guidance names nor the recorded evidence shows. tiebreaks{"demo-integration":null,"scene-kit":null,"presentation-skill":null,"verification-tooling":null,"engineering-quality":{"ok":true,"criteria":["engineering-preview-readiness-bounded","engineering-inspect-fails-loudly","engineering-tests-wait-on-state","engineering-tests-isolate-resources"],"inventory_kind":"neutral source","attempts":[{"stage":"tiebreak","attempt":1,"ok":true,"error":null},{"stage":"tiebreak-recite","attempt":1,"ok":true,"error":null}],"first_results":[{"id":"engineering-preview-readiness-bounded","verdict":"pass","rationale":"All three clauses are met. (1) Readiness is bounded. withPreview&#39;s wait loop runs at most 100 attempts with a 100 ms delay each, then throws &#39;Preview readiness timeout&#39;. It also fails early on a spawn error or a preview exit. readStepCount&#39;s wait uses waitFor({timeout:10000}). (2) Both verify() and inspectPresentation() call `await run(&#39;npm&#39;,[&#39;run&#39;,&#39;build&#39;])` before withPreview, so the preview starts only after the build completes. (3) Readiness polls the URL with fetch and never parses printed server output, so the ANSI/chunk clause does not apply. The bootstrap template copies are identical. Judge C&#39;s reason, that an individual fetch has no abort signal, does not decide the requirement. The wait for preview readiness is the attempt-capped loop, which ends in a readiness-timeout error. The cited source does not show a readiness request that never resolves. The guidance&#39;s failure cases are a readiness wait without a timeout, a preview started during the build, and fragile ready-URL parsing, and none of them is present.","evidence":["scripts/browser-runtime.mjs:36-42: `for (let attempt = 0; attempt &lt; 100; attempt++) { ... await fetch(url) ... await delay(100) }` then `if (!ready) throw new Error(&#39;Preview readiness timeout …","scripts/browser-runtime.mjs:75-76: readStepCount uses waitFor({ timeout: 10000 })","scripts/verify.mjs:17: `if (options.build) await run(&#39;npm&#39;, [&#39;run&#39;, &#39;build&#39;], cwd)` precedes withPreview at line 26","scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs:7: the awaited build precedes withPreview at line 11","The bootstrap template copies of browser-runtime.mjs, verify.mjs and inspect-presentation.mjs contain the same code"],"citations":[{"path":"scripts/browser-runtime.mjs","start_line":22,"end_line":46},{"path":"scripts/browser-runtime.mjs","start_line":75,"end_line":80},{"path":"scripts/verify.mjs","start_line":14,"end_line":29},{"path":"scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs","start_line":6,"end_line":15},{"path":"skills/presentation/templates/bootstrap/scripts/browser-runtime.mjs","start_line":22,"end_line":46},{"path":"skills/presentation/templates/bootstrap/scripts/verify.mjs","start_line":14,"end_line":29},{"path":"skills/presentation/templates/bootstrap/scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs","start_line":6,"end_line":15}],"search_scope":[],"missing_obligation":""},{"id":"engineering-inspect-fails-loudly","verdict":"pass","rationale":"All three clauses are met. (1) readStepCount runs Number(getAttribute(&#39;data-step-count&#39;)) and throws &#39;Invalid step count&#39; unless the result is a positive integer. A missing attribute gives Number(null) = 0, and a non-numeric one gives NaN, so missing, zero and non-numeric counts are all rejected. For the step index, visitSteps waits (4 s timeout) until data-step-index equals String(index). A missing or non-numeric index never matches, so the wait times out and throws. (2) That waitForFunction runs before every action(index) call, and action(index) is where the screenshot is taken. So each capture happens only after the reported index equals the intended step. (3) count must be at least 1, the loop runs count times and pushes one report entry per capture, and any thrown error sets process.exitCode = 1. Inspect therefore cannot report success with zero captures.
